name: Breeze Canna x Skunk House Pro Rosin Disposable Vape | Mod Banana
description: Born from an obsession with exceptional cannabis, SkunkHouse Genetics has been crafting elite genetics since 2008—combining standout terpene profiles, serious potency, and grower-focused structure that helped shape modern hash-making through their work with GMO. This hybrid features dense, crystalline buds, delivering sweet banana and diesel-skunk flavors with euphoric, relaxing effects that spark creativity and melt away stress.
